metadata.title: Volume Entropy and Scalar Curvature near a Hyperbolic Metric
metadata.abstract: Let $(M^n,g_0)$ be a closed hyperbolic manifold, $n\geq3$. We compute the Hessian of volume entropy at $g_0$ under the constraint $Sc_g=-n(n-1)$ and express it as a quadratic form on transverse-traceless symmetric two-tensors. In dimension three, the Hessian is negative definite, and every sufficiently $C^\infty$-close metric with $Sc_g\geq-6$ has entropy at most $2$, with equality precisely for pullbacks of $g_0$. In dimensions $n\geq4$, a universal spectral threshold determines the Hessian sign. Nonzero trace-free Codazzi tensors give positive directions, and hyperbolic bending provides smooth constrained entropy saddles in every such dimension.

analysis.progressType: hyperbolic metric 邻域的 entropy saddle
analysis.workSummary: 在 scalar=−n(n−1) 约束下计算 volume entropy 的 TT Hessian；三维为负定且 scalar≥−6 的近邻 entropy≤2，n≥4 有谱阈值及 Codazzi 正方向，bending 给 constrained saddle。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分三维局部极值与高维 saddle，揭示 scalar 约束的维数效应。
analysis.limitations: 三维比较要求足够 C∞ 接近；高维不能沿用 entropy 局部上界。
